title: Personal Budget & Expense Tracking CLI
description: Build an interactive command-line expense tracker in Python that records transactions, saves data to a local file, computes monthly summaries, and formats category breakdowns.
objectives: Demonstrate mastery of variables, loops, conditionals, and functions
Read and write data safely using JSON or CSV file storage
Handle invalid user inputs gracefully without crashing
requirements: CLI menu with options: Add Expense, List Expenses, View Summary, Exit
Persistent storage in expenses.json
Input validation for amounts (positive floats) and date formats
Unit tests verifying calculation functions
deliverables: GitHub repository URL with main.py and test_expenses.py
README.md with setup instructions and sample run terminal output

title: Full-Stack Task & Workflow Management API
description: Design and build a RESTful API service with database persistence, relational foreign key constraints, authentication, and comprehensive test suites.
objectives: Build REST endpoints with standard status codes and payload validation
Design relational database schema with users, projects, and task items
Implement JWT authentication and resource ownership checks
requirements: CRUD endpoints for tasks with pagination and status filtering
Relational SQLite / PostgreSQL schema with foreign keys
Automated integration test suite with >80% code coverage
Dockerized container for local reproduction
deliverables: GitHub repo with source code, migrations, and Dockerfile
Postman/Thunder client test collection or OpenAPI specification

title: Accessible Full-Stack Knowledge Base & Study App
description: Build a responsive, semantic web application with HTML/CSS Grid, React state management, search filtering, keyboard navigation, and REST API persistence.
objectives: Construct accessible semantic HTML landmarks and responsive CSS Grid layouts
Implement immutable React state updates with live search and category filters
Connect frontend forms to a validated backend API with error handling
requirements: Responsive layout working cleanly from 390px mobile to 1440px desktop
Full CRUD notes/flashcards persisted via backend API
WCAG AA contrast and keyboard-accessible modals and forms
Clean TypeScript interfaces for all domain models
deliverables: GitHub repository with frontend & backend source code
Live deployed URL and accessibility audit notes

title: Offline-First Daily Study & Habit Tracker Mobile App
description: Design and implement a thumb-friendly mobile application with stack and bottom-tab navigation, offline storage, streak tracking, and clean touch interactions.
objectives: Design mobile screens respecting safe area insets and 44px minimum touch targets
Implement Stack + Bottom Tab navigation without losing screen state
Persist habits locally so the app works seamlessly offline
requirements: 3 primary bottom tabs: Today, Progress, Settings
Create, complete, and edit daily habits with local persistence
Weekly streak visualization and clear empty/loading states
Unit tests for streak calculation logic
deliverables: GitHub repository (React Native / Expo or Flutter)
Screen walkthrough GIF or live Expo snack preview

title: Product Retention & A/B Experimentation Analytics Report
description: Analyze real-world user funnel data using Python, Pandas, and SQL to clean outliers, compute cohort retention, run hypothesis testing, and publish executive visual insights.
objectives: Clean missing values, duplicate events, and skewed outliers transparently
Compare control vs treatment groups using statistical significance checks
Communicate clear business recommendations backed by charts
requirements: Reproducible Python/Pandas notebook or modular analysis scripts
SQL cohort query aggregating weekly user retention
Median vs mean outlier impact comparison
Executive summary explaining correlation vs causation caveats
deliverables: GitHub repository with cleaned pipeline and SQL queries

title: End-to-End Real Estate Valuation & Feature Engineering Pipeline
description: Develop a reproducible machine learning pipeline that cleans tabular housing data, engineers geographical and temporal features, evaluates regression models, and outputs a trained model artifact.
objectives: Perform thorough exploratory data analysis (EDA) with distribution plots
Implement robust missing value imputation and scaling pipelines without data leakage
Compare multiple regression models using cross-validation and RMSE/MAE
requirements: Jupyter Notebook or clean modular Python scripts
Scikit-learn ColumnTransformer and Pipeline architecture
Hyperparameter tuning using GridSearchCV or Optuna
Exported model bundle with inference prediction script
deliverables: GitHub repository containing data pipeline, train script, and inference script
Written report analyzing model feature importance and limitations

title: Production Document Q&A Agent with Grounded RAG & Citations
description: Build an intelligent RAG application that ingests technical PDFs or documentation, embeds chunks into a vector database, retrieves grounded context, and answers questions with direct citations.
objectives: Implement recursive chunking and vector embedding generation
Build semantic retrieval pipeline with cosine similarity and threshold filtering
Synthesize answers citing exact section sources while preventing hallucination
requirements: Vector store integration (Chroma / FAISS / Qdrant)
Strict citation rubric ensuring no fabricated facts
Interactive web interface or CLI to ask questions
Evaluation benchmark testing retrieval accuracy
deliverables: GitHub repository with ingestion script, retrieval agent, and web UI
Demonstration video or interactive live URL

title: Web Security Hardening & Threat Model Lab
description: Audit a sample web application against the OWASP Top 10, remediate SQLi/XSS/broken-auth flaws, write automated security regression tests, and author a clear threat model.
objectives: Identify entry points, trust boundaries, and injection sinks
Replace raw SQL concatenation and unsafe HTML sinks with safe patterns
Implement rate limiting, salted password hashing, and strict input schemas
requirements: Written Threat Model covering CIA Triad risks
Parameterized database queries and output escaping patches
Automated test suite verifying XSS/SQLi payloads are neutralized
Zero hardcoded secrets in git history
deliverables: GitHub repository with hardened code and security test suite

title: Containerized Multi-Service App with Automated CI/CD
description: Package a web API and database using multi-stage Dockerfiles, orchestrate local stacks with Docker Compose, and configure a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with health checks.
objectives: Write a lean, non-root multi-stage Dockerfile with zero baked secrets
Configure health-check endpoints and persistent database volumes
Automate lint, unit tests, and container image build on every pull request
requirements: Multi-stage Dockerfile running as a non-root user
docker-compose.yml with service networking and volume mounts
CI workflow file running automated tests before build
Runbook documenting rollback and environment variable setup
deliverables: GitHub repository with Dockerfile, Compose config, and CI workflow
Architecture diagram and deployment runbook in README.md
